```yaml
name: Code Analysis

on:
  push:
    branches: [ master, main, develop ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ master, main, develop ]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  static-analysis:
    name: Static Analysis
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: '1.21'
          cache: true

      - name: Run golangci-lint
        uses: golangci/golangci-lint-action@v4
        with:
          version: latest
          args: --timeout=10m

  verify-retry-removal:
    name: Verify Retry Removal
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Check for removed retrier package
        run: |
          if [ -d "engine/access/rpc/backend/transactions/retrier" ]; then
            echo "::error::The retrier package should have been removed."
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "Retrier package successfully removed."

      - name: Check for removed CLI flag
        run: |
          if grep -r "retry-enabled" --include="*.go" .; then
            echo "::error::The 'retry-enabled' CLI flag should have been removed."
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "CLI flag 'retry-enabled' successfully removed."

      - name: Check for removed config parameter
        run: |
          if grep -r "RetryEnabled" --include="*.go" .; then
            echo "::error::The 'RetryEnabled' config parameter should have been removed."
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "Config parameter 'RetryEnabled' successfully removed."

      - name: Check for removed methods
        run: |
          if grep -r "RegisterTransaction\|ProcessFinalizedBlockHeight" --include="*.go" engine/access/rpc/backend/transactions/; then
            echo "::error::The methods 'RegisterTransaction' and 'ProcessFinalizedBlockHeight' should have been removed from transactions backend."
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "Methods successfully removed from transactions backend."

  build-and-test:
    name: Build and Test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: '1.21'
          cache: true

      - name: Build
        run: go build ./...

      - name: Test
        run: go test ./... -race -short
```
